items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: You'd play with him tonight, you wouldn't know nothing. So you come on the next job... you find somebody in your place.

ctx.x: No, but I tell you what's the matter, he's too much like that. If he wanted like that, he just wanted like that.

He's a little timid and all, but he's a real gentleman, everybody sees him. Yeah, yeah. Well, you were talking about Keo, how he worked. Was he hard to get along with? Did you mean that he changed bands a lot, or what did you mean?

Well, if them bands worked like that, if they didn't like a man, you see? They'd slow away and put him out. But they wouldn't come up and tell him. You'd play with him tonight, you wouldn't know nothing. So you come on the next job, when you get this, you find somebody in your place. Hey, what's that? Well, you know, I, geez, you know, I had to kick it on him, I had to get some money. Well, how come he didn't tell me? Well, I thought they told him. I thought they told him. That was the alibi, you know. Oh, man,…
